evidence.quote: We are prepared to raise rates further if appropriate, and intend to hold policy at a restrictive level until we are confident that inflation is moving sustainably down toward our objective.
Twelve-month core inflation is still elevated, and there is substantial further ground to cover to get back to price stability.
So far this year, GDP (gross domestic product) growth has come in above expectations and above its longer-run trend, and recent readings on consumer spending have been especially robust.
Additional evidence of persistently above-trend growth could put further progress on inflation at risk and could warrant further tightening of monetary policy.
we will proceed carefully as we decide whether to tighten further or, instead, to hold the policy rate constant and await further data.
We will keep at it until the job is done.

parsed.rationale: The speech keeps a tightening bias, stressing that inflation remains too high and that strong growth or a tight labor market could warrant further hikes. That bias is tempered by a commitment to proceed carefully and acknowledgment of two-sided risks, so the stance is moderately hawkish.
